capabilities.name: Cloud Sandbox Execution
capabilities.description: Creates isolated Celesto cloud computers for executing tasks.

capabilities.name: Python Runtime Provisioning
capabilities.description: Checks for Python and installs it when missing.

capabilities.name: Task Planning
capabilities.description: Creates rule-based execution plans based on user requests.

capabilities.name: Command Validation
capabilities.description: Checks commands against basic security rules.

capabilities.name: Sandbox Lifecycle Tracking
capabilities.description: Tracks sandbox creation, execution, completion, and cleanup.

capabilities.name: Persistent Sandbox Lifecycle
capabilities.description: Creates persistent computers and supports stopping and resuming the same computer.

capabilities.name: Computer ID Persistence
capabilities.description: Stores and retrieves the Celesto computer ID using PostgreSQL.

capabilities.name: Persistent Sandbox Deletion
capabilities.description: Deletes a persistent Celesto computer through the API.

capabilities.name: Execution Streaming
capabilities.description: Collects stdout, stderr, exit code, and execution duration from Celesto command events.
